statements.context: Andrew P. Petry serves as the Acting Deputy Chief Information Officer for Resource Management at the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE). He is a seasoned executive leader with nearly two decades of experience across the Departments of the Navy and Energy, specializing in leading enterprise transformation and fiscal stewardship through periods of significant change. With a leadership style that is both direct and human, Andrew is recognized for navigating complex operational and policy environments to deliver measurable outcomes. He has a proven record of leading federal and contractor teams through high-stakes transformations, including resolving a $3.5 billion acquisition protest while simultaneously identifying over $6.6 billion in in enterprise-wide savings through contract and acquisition reform. His expertise is in translating strategic priorities into sustained operational results. He has led major workforce realignments and budget transformations, consistently aligning the resources of a $420+ million enterprise IT portfolio to support critical national priorities such as AI adoption, cybersecurity, and enterprise IT consolidation.
